title: Comparing a comment with its loop
description: You can inspect the supplied accumulator before considering any changes.

steps.description: The comment states the intended result, while total starts at zero. You can compare that intention with the executable lines below.
The loop uses range(5). Its bound determines the values supplied to i.

steps.question: Will the recorded program print the comment's intended result?
steps.answer: No. The supplied run prints The sum is 10.

steps.description: You update total inside the loop and print it once afterward. The observed 10 gives you a concrete result to investigate against the stated intention.
